overviews.name: CARDSVC
key_points: Runs card servicing: the CA00 online menu and authorization chain for card accounts, and the nightly posting, monthly billing and weekly reference-rebuild batch cycles over CARDDB.
Program selection is table-driven: online and batch dispatchers resolve route keys from CARDSVC.PGM_ROUTE, which is also how card authorisations and nightly exposure recalculation reach Party & Risk.
Owns the card DB2 tables and VSAM clusters; Party & Risk reads CARDSVC.ACCOUNT and CARD_LIMIT directly under a cross-database grant.

descriptions.name: CACRD00
descriptions.description: CA00 main menu: turns the selected option into a MENU route key (OPT01-OPT10, OPTX) and links CACRD90 to transfer to the servicing program.
key_points: Entry program of CICS transaction CA00; pseudo-conversational, each pass ends with RETURN TRANSID('CA00').
Does not know which program serves an option - the route key is resolved by the dispatcher from CARDSVC.PGM_ROUTE.

descriptions.name: CACRD01
descriptions.description: Menu option 1 account inquiry: reads CARDSVC.ACCOUNT and shows balances, cycle dates, delinquency and minimum payment.

descriptions.name: CACRD02
descriptions.description: Menu option 2 card list: pages through the cards of an account over the CARDXREF alternate-index path, ten per page.

descriptions.name: CACRD03
descriptions.description: Menu option 3 card detail: shows card status, expiry, block reason and today's limits from CARDSVC.CARD and CARD_LIMIT.

descriptions.name: CACRD04
descriptions.description: First step of the online authorization chain: edits the request screen, builds the auth-record skeleton on TSQ CARDAUTQ and passes to CACRD05.

descriptions.name: CACRD05
descriptions.description: Authorization risk step: asks the dispatcher for route XMOD/RISKSVC to obtain the Party & Risk opinion, then continues to CACRD06 or CACRD09.
key_points: The load module answering XMOD/RISKSVC is not named here; the seeded route row points at PARTYRSK program PRKYC01 with CACRD92 as fallback.
RC 8 from the risk service jumps straight to the decision step; RC 12 goes to the error handler.

descriptions.name: CACRD06
descriptions.description: Authorization status step: applies the card and account status, expiry, PIN-try and delinquency rules and records the verdict.

descriptions.name: CACRD07
descriptions.description: Authorization fraud step: picks the STANDARD or HIGHRISK rule class and drives the FRAU handler pipeline through the dispatcher.
key_points: Asks CACRD90 for FRAU/<class> sequence 1, 2, 3... until no route is returned; the strongest action (DECL > REFR > FLAG > SCOR) wins.
In the seeded route table the FRAU rows carry CALL_TYPE 'D', which the online dispatcher rejects, so as coded the pipeline would end at the first sequence.

descriptions.name: CACRD08
descriptions.description: Authorization limit step: checks the amount against today's CARD_LIMIT row less pending authorisations, with the product over-limit tolerance.

descriptions.name: CACRD09
descriptions.description: Authorization decision: applies the fixed precedence of sanctions, risk, status, fraud, limit and KYC verdicts to approve, refer or decline.

descriptions.name: CACRD10
descriptions.description: Authorization record write: inserts CARDSVC.AUTHORIZATION, updates pending and limit amounts on approval and logs the image to ESDS AUTHLOG.

descriptions.name: CACRD11
descriptions.description: Menu option 5 card maintenance: block, unblock, replace and reissue a plastic on CARDSVC.CARD and the CARDXREF file.

descriptions.name: CACRD12
descriptions.description: Menu option 6 credit limit change: applies small increases directly and gets a Party & Risk opinion via route XMOD/KYCINQ for larger ones.

descriptions.name: CACRD13
descriptions.description: Menu option 7 dispute entry: raises a dispute against a posted transaction and posts a provisional credit when it qualifies.

descriptions.name: CACRD14
descriptions.description: Menu option 8 payment posting: posts or same-day reverses a counter or telephone payment in one syncpoint.

descriptions.name: CACRD15
descriptions.description: Menu option 9 customer/KYC inquiry: read-only card view of the customer with the risk and KYC opinion from route XMOD/KYCINQ.

descriptions.name: CACRD16
descriptions.description: Menu option 10 reference lookup: browses reason codes on the RSNCODE KSDS and merchants on CARDSVC.MERCHANT.

descriptions.name: CACRD17
descriptions.description: CA00 session exit: writes the session audit to TDQ CAUD, deletes the route cache and auth queues and ends the pseudo-conversation.

descriptions.name: CACRD90
descriptions.description: Online route dispatcher: resolves a route type/key/sequence from CARDSVC.PGM_ROUTE (TSQ cache, VSAM PGMROUT fallback) and LINKs or XCTLs.
key_points: Route rows are loaded once per task into TSQ CARDRTQ; if DB2 is unavailable the VSAM copy PGMROUT is read.
Only CALL_TYPE 'L' (LINK) and 'X' (XCTL) are dispatched online; on PGMIDERR the row's FALLBACK_PGM is tried once.

descriptions.name: CACRD91
descriptions.description: CARDSVC online error handler: logs the caller's error area and, by severity, returns, sends the diagnostic screen or abends the task.

descriptions.name: CACRD92
descriptions.description: Cross-module route fallback: answers an XMOD risk request conservatively (band X, advice REFR, RC 4) when the Party & Risk target cannot be loaded.

descriptions.name: CAFRD01
descriptions.description: Fraud rule handler for velocity: scores the authorisation against FRAUD_RULE velocity parameters (route FRAU sequence 1).

descriptions.name: CAFRD02
descriptions.description: Fraud rule handler for geography and merchant category lists on the rule row (route FRAU sequence 2).

descriptions.name: CAFRD03
descriptions.description: Fraud rule handler for amount patterns - round-amount probing, structuring, repeated amounts (route FRAU/STANDARD sequence 3).

descriptions.name: CAFRD04
descriptions.description: Fraud rule handler for merchant and acquirer reputation (FRAU/STANDARD seq 4, FRAU/HIGHRISK seq 3).

descriptions.name: CBBIL01
descriptions.description: CARDBILL step 1: selects the accounts whose cycle day matches the control card onto the billing work file and opens the cycle in CYCLCTL.

descriptions.name: CBBIL02
descriptions.description: CARDBILL step 2: assembles one statement record per account from the cycle's posted transactions with balances and category buckets.

descriptions.name: CBBIL03
descriptions.description: CARDBILL step 3: computes the minimum payment and payment due date and updates CARDSVC.ACCOUNT.

descriptions.name: CBBIL04
descriptions.description: CARDBILL step 4: turns the CUSTPREF delivery preference into a STMT route key and hands each statement to the batch dispatcher to render.

descriptions.name: CBBIL05
descriptions.description: CARDBILL step 5: inserts rendered statements into CARDSVC.STATEMENT and writes the variable-length archive image.

descriptions.name: CBBIL06
descriptions.description: CARDBILL step 6: reconciles statements against the selection and account balances and marks the cycle complete only when the proof passes.

descriptions.name: CBCRD01
descriptions.description: CARDNITE step 1: extracts the cycle date's records from the AUTHLOG ESDS to the extract GDG and creates the cycle control record.

descriptions.name: CBCRD02
descriptions.description: CARDNITE step 2: edits every extract record by authorisation type and splits clean records from rejects with reason codes.

descriptions.name: CBCRD03
descriptions.description: CARDNITE step 3: enriches the sorted clean file with merchant data from VSAM MERCHRTE and CARDSVC.MERCHANT.

descriptions.name: CBCRD04
descriptions.description: CARDNITE step 4: posts enriched authorisations into CARDSVC.TRANSACTION, moves account balances and marks the authorisation posted.

descriptions.name: CBCRD05A
descriptions.description: CARDNITE job 5A: runs the CBCRD05A fee assessment branch in parallel with 5B.

descriptions.name: CBCRD05B
descriptions.description: CARDNITE job 5B: runs the CBCRD05B interest and rewards branch in parallel with 5A.

descriptions.name: CBCRD06A
descriptions.description: CBCRD06J step 1: builds the party exposure work list, one record per account the cycle posted to.

descriptions.name: CBCRD06B
descriptions.description: CBCRD06J step 3: sends each party's risk area to the batch dispatcher on route XMOD/RSKRECAL for Party & Risk recalculation.
key_points: The answering load module is not named here; the seeded route points at PARTYRSK entry point PRBRSK1.

descriptions.name: CBCRD06C
descriptions.description: CBCRD06J step 4: applies accepted risk bands to the parties' current credit limit rows and reports deteriorations.

descriptions.name: CBCRD06W
descriptions.description: CBCRD06J join check: verifies both the fee and interest branches posted their completion flags in CYCLCTL before the join proceeds.

descriptions.name: CBCRD06X
descriptions.description: CBCRD06J step 2: sorts the party work list and collapses each party's accounts into one record with summed exposure.

descriptions.name: CBCRD07
descriptions.description: Nightly general ledger posting: aggregates the cycle's transactions into balanced double-entry rows on CARDSVC.GL_POSTING.

descriptions.name: CBCRD08
descriptions.description: Nightly delinquency roll: moves ACCOUNT.DELQ_BUCKET for unpaid minimum payments and prints the aging report.

descriptions.name: CBCRD09
descriptions.description: Nightly backup verification: counts and hashes the new VSAM backup generations against the cycle control record.

descriptions.name: CBCRD10
descriptions.description: CARDNITE close: marks the cycle complete, prints the nightly control report and signals whether the online region may reopen.

descriptions.name: CBCRD90
descriptions.description: Batch route dispatcher: resolves a route from CARDSVC.PGM_ROUTE (VSAM PGMROUT fallback), dynamically CALLs the target and CANCELs it.

descriptions.name: CBFEE01
descriptions.description: Fee handler for annual and late fees (routes FEEC/ANNU and FEEC/LATE), posting to CARDSVC.TRANSACTION and ACCOUNT.

descriptions.name: CBFEE02
descriptions.description: Fee handler for over-limit and cash-advance fees (routes FEEC/OVLM and FEEC/CASH).

descriptions.name: CBFEE03
descriptions.description: Fee handler for foreign transaction fees (route FEEC/FRGN).

descriptions.name: CBREF01
descriptions.description: CARDREF step 1: applies the weekly acquirer merchant feed to CARDSVC.MERCHANT.

descriptions.name: CBREF02
descriptions.description: CARDREF step 2: unloads CARDSVC.MERCHANT for the MERCHRTE VSAM rebuild and verifies the rebuilt cluster count (PARM UNLOAD/VERIFY).

descriptions.name: CBREF03
descriptions.description: CARDREF step 3: unloads FRAUD_RULE and the reason-code feed for the FRAUDRUL/RSNCODE rebuild and verifies the counts.

descriptions.name: CBREF04
descriptions.description: CARDREF step 4: unloads active, in-date PGM_ROUTE rows as the PGMROUT VSAM fallback image and verifies the rebuilt cluster.

descriptions.name: CBREF05
descriptions.description: CARDREF step 5: read-only reference integrity report - orphans, route table sanity and VSAM versus DB2 counts.

descriptions.name: CBSTM01
descriptions.description: Statement formatter for paper delivery (route STMT/PAPR): writes the print image to STMTPRT.

descriptions.name: CBSTM02
descriptions.description: Statement formatter for electronic delivery (route STMT/ELEC): writes the vendor pipe-delimited extract to STMTEXT.

descriptions.name: BINDCARD
descriptions.description: Binds every CARDSVC package into collection CARDCOLL and the four card application plans.

descriptions.name: BINDPRTY
descriptions.description: Binds every PARTYRSK package into collection PRTYCOLL and the two Party & Risk plans; must run before BINDCARD.

descriptions.name: BUILDALL
descriptions.description: Full rebuild of the card estate from source: assembler, CICS and batch COBOL members of both modules.

descriptions.name: CBBIL01J
descriptions.description: CARDBILL job 1 of 6: runs CBBIL01 to select the billing cycle's accounts.

descriptions.name: CBBIL02J
descriptions.description: CARDBILL job 2 of 6: runs CBBIL02 statement assembly onto the variable-length statement work file.

descriptions.name: CBBIL03J
descriptions.description: CARDBILL job 3 of 6: runs CBBIL03 minimum payment and due-date calculation.

descriptions.name: CBBIL04J
descriptions.description: CARDBILL job 4 of 6: runs CBBIL04 statement rendering through the batch dispatcher.

descriptions.name: CBBIL05J
descriptions.description: CARDBILL job 5 of 6: runs CBBIL05 statement persistence and seven-year archive.

descriptions.name: CBBIL06J
descriptions.description: CARDBILL job 6 of 6: runs CBBIL06 reconciliation and cycle close.

descriptions.name: CBCRD01J
descriptions.description: CARDNITE job 1: runs CBCRD01 authorization log extract to the AUTHEXTR GDG.

descriptions.name: CBCRD02J
descriptions.description: CARDNITE job 2: runs CBCRD02 edit and reject split.

descriptions.name: CBCRD03J
descriptions.description: CARDNITE job 3: DFSORT of the clean extract then CBCRD03 merchant enrichment.

descriptions.name: CBCRD04J
descriptions.description: CARDNITE job 4: runs CBCRD04 transaction posting with commit-point restart.

descriptions.name: CBCRD05A
descriptions.description: CARDNITE job 5A: runs the CBCRD05A fee assessment branch in parallel with 5B.

descriptions.name: CBCRD05B
descriptions.description: CARDNITE job 5B: runs the CBCRD05B interest and rewards branch in parallel with 5A.

descriptions.name: CBCRD06J
descriptions.description: CARDNITE job 6: joins the branches, builds and dedups the party work list, calls Party & Risk recalculation and applies the bands.

descriptions.name: CBCRD07J
descriptions.description: CARDNITE job 7: runs CBCRD07 general ledger feed.

descriptions.name: CBCRD08J
descriptions.description: CARDNITE job 8: runs CBCRD08 delinquency roll, aging report and collections feed.

descriptions.name: CBCRD09J
descriptions.description: CARDNITE job 9: IDCAMS export/repro of CYCLCTL, CARDXREF and AUTHLOG, AUTHLOG redefine, then CBCRD09 verification.

descriptions.name: CBCRD10J
descriptions.description: CARDNITE job 10: runs CBCRD10 cycle close and control report.

descriptions.name: CBREF01J
descriptions.description: CARDREF job 1 of 5: runs CBREF01 merchant reference refresh.

descriptions.name: CBREF02J
descriptions.description: CARDREF job 2 of 5: unload, sort, delete/define, repro and verify of VSAM MERCHRTE.

descriptions.name: CBREF03J
descriptions.description: CARDREF job 3 of 5: rebuilds VSAM FRAUDRUL and RSNCODE and verifies the counts.

descriptions.name: CBREF04J
descriptions.description: CARDREF job 4 of 5: rebuilds the PGMROUT VSAM fallback copy from CARDSVC.PGM_ROUTE.

descriptions.name: CBREF05J
descriptions.description: CARDREF job 5 of 5: runs CBREF05 reference integrity report.

descriptions.name: CSDUPCRD
descriptions.description: Applies the card servicing CICS resource definitions to the CSD of production region CICSCARD via DFHCSDUP.

descriptions.name: DEFCARD
descriptions.description: Install job that defines the CARDSVC VSAM clusters.

descriptions.name: DEFPARTY
descriptions.description: Install job that defines the PARTYRSK VSAM clusters under their own HLQ.

descriptions.name: CARDDB2
descriptions.description: PROC that runs a CARDSVC DB2 batch program under IKJEFT01/TSO; callers override SYSTSIN and add application DDs.

descriptions.name: COBASM
descriptions.description: PROC that assembles and links the HLASM subroutine as a separate load module for static inclusion by COBOL link edits.

descriptions.name: COBBATCH
descriptions.description: PROC that precompiles, compiles and link-edits batch COBOL programs (no CICS translate), CALLOPT selecting DYNAM or NODYNAM.

descriptions.name: COBCICS
descriptions.description: PROC that translates, precompiles, compiles and link-edits CICS/DB2 online COBOL programs.
